Addressed latest feedback from 2026-04-16 09:54 log.

Changes in commit 742475b9:
- Building, Labyrinth, and Labyrinth2 now bind HUD ammo signals and initial HUD state to the C# Player.CurrentWeapon first, instead of probing child weapon nodes in a fixed order. This avoids stale/transitional weapon children driving ammo HUD state.
- Shotgun startup display still uses ShellsInTube/ReserveAmmo, while non-shotgun weapons use CurrentAmmo/ReserveAmmo.
- Added regression coverage for stale child weapon selection breaking Building and Labyrinth2 HUD setup.
- Added the new owner log to docs/case-studies/issue-1808/logs and updated the case study root cause.

Verification:
- dotnet build GodotTopDownTemplate.sln passed locally (existing warnings only).
- Godot/GUT was not run locally because no godot/godot4 binary is installed in this environment. GitHub checks are queued on the pushed commit.
